raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation Literal `` / `` tokens in prompt text are incorrectly treated as visual boundaries by Nemotron VL's marker-pair padding. Unmatched markers can leave visual rows unpadded; balanced literal pairs can pad text instead, causing an embedding-row mismatch and potentially a CUDA assertion. ## Modifications Pad image/video spans using the processor's recorded offsets rather than searching the prompt for marker pairs. Preserve literal text, visual data offsets, and existing audio padding. ## Accuracy Tests All **6 CPU tests** in the existing `test_nano_nemotron_vl_processor.py` pass. The added regression covers stray start/end markers, balanced literal pairs, and audio-padding preservation. The complete stack is tree-identical to the previous combined version of #44581. Project isort/ruff checks pass. GPU/serving validation has not been rerun for this split. ## Speed Tests and Profiling Not benchmarked; no performance claim or kernel changes. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :white_check_mark: [Run #39681793902](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39681793902) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #39681793851](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39681793851) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #39681793932](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39681793932)
